About

Lionel Messi is a 38-year-old football player who plays as a striker for Inter Miami CF, born on June 24, 1987, who is left-footed. Follow Lionel Messi on FotMob for live match updates, detailed statistics, career history, transfer news, FotMob ratings, and comprehensive performance analytics.

In the 2026 Major League Soccer season, Lionel Messi has recorded 12 goals, 7 assists, 1,243 minutes, an average FotMob rating of 8.47, 2 yellow cards.

Lionel Messi scores highly on Goals, Assists, and Rating compared to strikers in the Major League Soccer.

Lionel Messi currently plays for Inter Miami CF alongside Gonzalo Luján, Sergio Reguilón, Facundo Mura, Rodrigo De Paul, Telasco Segovia, Luis Suárez, Luis Barraza, Micael, Ian Fray, Germán Berterame, Santiago Morales, Tadeo Allende, David Ayala, Mateo Silvetti, Tyler Hall, Noah Allen, Rocco Ríos Novo, Maximiliano Falcón, David Ruiz, Yannick Bright, Dániel Pintér, Preston Plambeck, Israel Boatwright, Ezequiel Abadia-Reda, Alexander Shaw, and Dayne St. Clair. Visit their player pages on FotMob to explore detailed statistics, performance ratings, and career information.

Lionel Messi's career has also included time at MLS All-Stars, Paris Saint-Germain, and Barcelona.

On the international stage, Lionel Messi has represented Argentina, Argentina U23, and Argentina U20.

Lionel Messi is from Argentina, and the national teams include Juan Musso, Marcos Senesi, Nicolás Tagliafico, Gonzalo Montiel, Leandro Paredes, Lisandro Martínez, Rodrigo De Paul, Valentín Barco, Julián Álvarez, Giovani Lo Celso, Gerónimo Rulli, Cristian Romero, Exequiel Palacios, Nicolás González, Thiago Almada, Giuliano Simeone, Nico Paz, Nicolás Otamendi, Alexis Mac Allister, José López, Lautaro Martínez, Emiliano Martínez, Enzo Fernández, Facundo Medina, Nahuel Molina, Priscila Siben, Solana Pereyra, Adriana Sachs, Eliana Stábile, Catalina Roggerone, Justina Morcillo, Vanina Preininger, Aldana Cometti, Margarita Giménez, Daiana Falfán, Kishi Núñez, Dalila Ippólito, Maricel Pereyra, Lara Esponda, Sophía Braun, Milagros Martín, Flor Bonsegundo, Sofía Domínguez, Francisca Altgelt, Catalina Ongaro, Agostina Holzheier, Paulina Gramaglia, and Abigaíl Cháves. Explore each player's page on FotMob for comprehensive statistics, match history, and international career data.

Throughout their career, Lionel Messi has won 53 titles: MLS (2025) and Leagues Cup (2023) with Inter Miami CF, Trophée des Champions (2022/2023) and Ligue 1 (2022/2023, 2021/2022) with Paris Saint-Germain, Copa America (2024 USA, 2021 Brazil), World Cup (2022 Qatar), and CONMEBOL/UEFA Finalissima (2022) with Argentina, Supercopa de Catalunya (2018), LaLiga (2018/2019, 2017/2018, 2015/2016, 2014/2015, 2012/2013, 2010/2011, 2009/2010, 2008/2009, 2005/2006, 2004/2005), Champions League (2014/2015, 2010/2011, 2008/2009, 2005/2006), Copa Catalunya (2013/2014), Audi Cup (2011), UEFA Super Cup (2015/2016, 2011/2012, 2009/2010), Copa del Rey (2020/2021, 2017/2018, 2016/2017, 2015/2016, 2014/2015, 2011/2012, 2008/2009), FIFA Club World Cup (2015 Japan, 2011 Japan, 2009 UAE), Trofeo Joan Gamper (2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016), and Supercopa de España (2018/2019, 2016/2017, 2013/2014, 2011/2012, 2010/2011, 2009/2010, 2006/2007, 2005/2006) with Barcelona, and Summer Olympics (2008 Beijing) with Argentina U23.

Lionel Messi has competed in Major League Soccer, CONCACAF Champions Cup, World Cup, FIFA Club World Cup, Leagues Cup, Copa America, US Open Cup, World Cup CONMEBOL qualification, Ligue 1, Coupe de France, Champions League, Finalissima, Super Cup, LaLiga, Copa del Rey, and Super Cup.
